assumptions.assumption: The model assumes that a Petri net is composed of one or more transitions, places, and arcs, but does not specify the exact number.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R5 is not supported by the model, as there is no class named PTArc.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a class named PTArc to the model.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R6 is not supported by the model, as there is no class named TPArc.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a class named TPArc to the model.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R11 is not supported by the model, as the relationship between Net and Place is not one to many.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Change the association Net -> Place to [1..0..*] to represent one to many relationship.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R8 is not supported by the model, as there is no relationship between Place and Tparcs.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add an association Place -> Tparcs [0..*] to the model.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R9 is not supported by the model, as there is no relationship between Transition and Net.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a relationship Transition -> Net [1] to the model.
